decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting is a niche, specialist line with long procurement cycles and robust-application positioning, so it stays on the market despite modest visibility.
The C80-P G2 general interior luminaire is a core LED product line with its own page, fitting the firm's efficient indoor lighting strategy, and it remains listed.
The microprismatic pendant C94-P was promoted as a latest release in 2024 and matches the ergonomic office-lighting focus, so it is likely to be kept.
The marine searchlight survived while its HMI sibling was dropped, which suggests it is the retained, likely more modern variant, though the marine niche carries some risk.
